description: Perform Bader charge analysis on the NiO rock salt (100) surface.
user_prompt: Perform Bader charge analysis on the NiO (100) surface (rock salt structure, Fm-3m). Report the Bader net charge (in electrons) for a bulk-like Ni atom in the slab.

references: Pasti, Dobrota, Migas, Johansson & Skorodumova, arXiv:2108.08578 (2021); publ. Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 25, 7974 (2023)
method.modeling: Rock-salt NiO (Fm-3m); non-polar (100) slab (>= 4 NiO layers, vacuum >= 15 Angstrom).

key_parameters.dft+u: U(Ni 3d) = 6.5 eV, U(O 2p) = 9 eV; J = 1 eV for both (recommended)

method.rationale: Value from Pasti et al. 2021: they report pristine bulk NiO Ni Bader = +1.27 e; this bulk value is used as a reference for a bulk-like interior Ni in a (100) slab. The key_parameters are the recommended VASP protocol. Tolerance +/-0.2 e absolute.
